target_questions.question: Does high-magnification shadowgraphy resolve sheet, ligament, and secondary-droplet features hidden by conventional imaging?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 C016 relies on synchronized imaging and C007 emphasizes multiscale breakup; this paper tests diagnostic observability.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The high-magnification, high-speed shadowgraph method resolves the full breakup evolution and detailed sheet, ligament, and secondary-droplet structures that conventional shadowgraphy misses at high Weber number.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: A long-distance microscope and short-pulse fluorescence backlight reduce coherence artifacts and improve spatial/temporal resolution of the breakup zone.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: visual separation of early wave and later aerodynamic breakup stages

limitations: Short optical-method paper; diagnostic capability rather than a complete regime map.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
